title: Canonical one-variable deletions of the Run-002 exact minima
research_question: How many genuine symmetry classes remain after minimizing the exact certificates, and what exact obstruction survives after deleting each support variable?
scientific_output: An independently verified canonical taxonomy of every one-variable deletion, with exact child certificates and a clear decision whether a long deletion run has any value.
next_decision: If the family collapses to target_zero, stop spending long-run compute on it and require all three monochromatic perfect matchings in the next search.
